categories.name: phishing
categories.description: A message attempts to lure someone into a link, reply, or disclosure.
safety_actions: Do not use the message link

categories.name: UPI scam
categories.description: A payment or QR prompt may be framed as a refund or receipt.
warning_signs: Asked to enter PIN to receive money
safety_actions: Never enter a PIN to receive funds
Confirm in the official payment app

categories.name: OTP scam
categories.description: A one-time code is requested to gain access or approve an action.
warning_signs: Someone asks you to read or forward a code
safety_actions: Contact the service using a known channel

categories.name: job scam
categories.description: A fake job or recruiter may demand a fee or sensitive documents early.
safety_actions: Do not pay to secure a job

categories.name: investment scam
categories.description: A scheme may promise unusually high or guaranteed returns.
safety_actions: Do not send money under pressure

categories.name: parcel scam
categories.description: A delivery notice requests a small fee or login details through a link.
safety_actions: Use the courier's official app or site

categories.name: lottery scam
categories.description: An unexpected prize is used to solicit fees or personal details.
safety_actions: Do not pay to claim an unsolicited prize

categories.name: bank impersonation
categories.description: A sender claims to represent a bank and requests an urgent action.
safety_actions: Call the number on your card or bank site

categories.name: government impersonation
categories.description: A sender uses official-sounding threats or penalties to create fear.
safety_actions: Navigate to the official government portal independently

categories.name: customer-support scam
categories.description: A fake support contact requests remote access, payment, or a code.
safety_actions: End the call and find verified support details

categories.name: social-media recovery scam
categories.description: A fake recovery helper asks for a login code or credentials.
safety_actions: Use the platform's official recovery flow

categories.name: romance scam
categories.description: A person builds trust then creates an urgent financial request.
safety_actions: Talk with someone you trust before sending money

categories.name: QR scam
categories.description: A QR code may open an untrusted payment or credential page.
